provenance.note: Identical llama_cpp build_sha and model_hash as the committed paper Run B — comparison is like-for-like.

gateway_route_latency.measurement_caveat: This metric times route_with_retrieval ONLY (retrieval + CE gate + ATB splice). It explicitly sets decode_us=0 and does NOT include first-token generation. It is routing+splice latency, NOT time-to-first-token.
gateway_route_latency.verdict: CANONICAL. Replaces both committed headlines (171 ms Run A, 237 ms Run B); neither reproduces.

l0_radix_microbench.verdict: CANONICAL. Reproduces the paper's committed l0_radix_metrics.csv (69.5%, 3.04 us). Supersedes README's n=1 66%.

p20_margin_calibration.verdict: CANONICAL. Bit-exact reproduction of committed src/nexus_calibration.py.

retrieval_recall.verdict: CANONICAL. Dense R@1 0.87 reproduces exactly. CE R@1 is 0.88 (NOT the 0.90 claimed in README/RELEASE) and does not meet the 0.90 target.

superseded_contaminated_run.reason: ran concurrently with another e2e (resource contention inflated absolutes: B3=2011ms vs clean 1214ms). Retained for provenance; NOT canonical.
superseded_contaminated_run.process_note: An earlier raw/e2e_n30.json (valid, 195KB, also concurrent) was erroneously deleted during cleanup; this clean serial run replaces it.

e2e_baselines_and_true_ttft.confidence: MEDIUM (n=30, clean serial). Clean B3=1214ms is consistent with prior committed runs (1330/1498ms), confirming the n=25 inflation was contention.
e2e_baselines_and_true_ttft.verdict: CANONICAL. KEY FINDING: like-for-like Nexus(N1x)-vs-B3 true-TTFT speedup is 2.34x (518ms vs 1214ms), far below the headline 6.3x (which divided route-only 160ms by full-TTFT B3 = a misleading 7.6x). N1x acc 0.87 vs B3 0.93 = ~6-point trade-off at n=30 (gateway n=500 accuracy is 0.89).
